question: Show Non-Small Cell Lung PD-L1, CTLA-4 trials conducted in 2018 or later.

llama.answer: This query will return trials conducted in 2018 or later that are focused on Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC) and involve PD-L1 or CTLA-4 inhibitors.
llama.raw:
```json
{
  "sql": "SELECT \"nct\", \"author\", \"year\", \"pubmed_id\", \"trial_name\", \"ici_name\", \"ici_class\", \"cancer_type\", \"treatment_regimen\" FROM public.\"clinical_trials\" WHERE \"year\" >= 2018 AND \"cancer_type\" ILIKE '%NSCLC%' AND (\"ici_class\" ILIKE 'PD-L1' OR \"ici_class\" ILIKE 'CTLA-4')",
  "answer": "This query will return trials conducted in 2018 or later that are focused on Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC) and involve PD-L1 or CTLA-4 inhibitors.",
  "assumptions": ""
}
```
